note: Verdicts for spans the mechanical match could not resolve. covered = a claim does account for it; gap = a real hole; not-an-assertion = the span states no result of its own.

spans.why: No claim states the null interaction between expected-value difference and condition; the EV claim covers only the main effect and the condition claim only the choice-rate difference.

Figure 2C/F caption asserts a real finding — higher fitted risk-aversion parameter in Social than Solo in Study 1 only — and no claim covers the rho parameter (the risk-premium claim is a different measure and a null in both studies).

The significant Study 1 risk-aversion difference and its Study 2 non-replication are unclaimed; risk-premiums-null-social-solo asserts a null on a different measure, so it cannot stand in for a positive effect.
The claim asserts the Responsibility model outfits models without responsibility weighting, which is exactly this R-squared comparison.
Same model-comparison finding, stated for adjusted R-squared against the Basic model.
Methodological narration plus a cross-reference to the parameter-recovery supplement; no result of its own.
Summary sentence that lottery outcomes and decision-maker identity shape happiness; the decision-maker part is precisely this claim.
The partner-outcome by decision-maker interaction is the statistical form of the guilt effect the claim states.
The null for positive partner outcomes is a different condition from any claim; guilt-effect-independent-of-own-outcome concerns the participant's own outcome, not the partner's gains.

Figure 4C caption asserts that only precuneus and TPJ are most active for lottery choices in Social; the cluster claim covers three regions in the Social contrast, not this choice-type-specific narrowing.
Figure-caption bookkeeping line pointing to Appendix 1—table 4; states no result of its own.
Figure 4D panel label describing what the panel displays, with no finding stated.
Figure-caption bookkeeping line pointing to Appendix 1—table 6; states no result of its own.
Analysis-strategy narration explaining why per-region models were run; the omnibus effects are explicitly not shown.
Methodological narration describing the risky-minus-safe contrast and the LMM comparisons performed.
Methodological narration about model selection with and without the Run factor, plus table cross-references.
The region-level result isolating precuneus and TPJ as most active for risky choices in Social — and excluding mPFC — is not asserted by the three-cluster Social-contrast claim.

The outcome-phase network for lottery versus safe outcomes (insula, dmPFC, STS, striatum, dlPFC, IPL) is unclaimed; the striatum claims concern the decision phase and expected value, not outcome receipt.
Analysis-strategy narration mirroring the earlier per-region approach; omnibus effects explicitly not shown.
A sub-threshold left IFG cluster in the connectivity analysis that failed correction is not covered; the only IFG claim asserts an insula-seed effect without this caveat.
Left IFG connectivity with the STS seed, in the opposite direction and failing correction, is a different seed region and different direction from the insula-IFG claim.
Title label of Figure 5—figure supplement 1 naming the seed and conditions shown; no finding stated.
Caption restating the sub-threshold STS-to-IFG connectivity result; same unclaimed finding as results-144.
The significantly positive dot products with the guilt signature are the evidence behind the claim that the insula guilt effect is consistent with the published signature.
Bare figure title ('Figure 1. Experimental design.') stating no result.
Blanket statistical annotation plus a pure cross-reference to Appendix 1—table 4, not a finding of its own.
Same blanket significance note plus cross-reference to Appendix 1—table 6.
Describes graphical encoding (dots, means, 95% CI error bars) and then a bare supplement title.

Reports an uncorrected STS-seed to left inferior frontal gyrus connectivity cluster with a specific Safe-for-self/Risky-for-both pattern; the only IFG connectivity claim concerns the insula seed and the guilt effect, a different seed and contrast.
Raw model-comparison numbers (R2, BIC, AIC) plus the Key resources software listing; the model-comparison finding itself is asserted in the prose claims.
Raw cluster coordinate rows for contrasts already asserted as claims (Risky>Safe striatum; Social>Solo precuneus/TPJ/mPFC).

Only place reporting the decision-phase mixed-model Social-vs-Solo coefficients, including a significant negative ventral striatum and mPFC effect and session (run) interactions, which no claim covers and which sits in tension with the 'irrespective of Social or Solo' striatum claim.

Only place reporting decision-phase Social-vs-Partner mixed-model effects in ventral striatum, mPFC, precuneus and TPJ; claims cover Social vs Solo at choice and Social vs Partner only for insula at outcome.

Only place reporting the outcome-phase risky-vs-safe network (bilateral insula, dorsomedial PFC, right STS, striatum, parietal, Cohen's d up to 2.38), the contrast that defines the later ROIs; no claim states it.

Mixed-model confirmation that bilateral insula response to low partner outcomes is higher in the Social condition, i.e. the insula guilt effect stated without these numbers (the small negative right mid-temporal coefficient is the one loose thread).
Mixed-model confirmation that the low-minus-high outcome response difference is larger in the Social condition in bilateral insula, the same effect the insula guilt claim asserts.
